question: 부산센터 SKU-040 발주점이 몇이야?

question: 지금 재고가 완전히 바닥난 SKU-거점 있으면 알려줘

question: SKU-021 예측 수량 13주치 다 더하면 얼마야?

question: 지난주 서울센터 전체 출고량 합계 좀 뽑아줘

question: 이번 달 들어서 SKU-005는 몇 개 팔렸어?
goldenSql: SELECT SUM(qty) FROM scm.sales_daily WHERE sku = 'SKU-005' AND sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-11-01' AND DATE '2026-11-08'

question: 10월 카테고리별 판매량 정리해줘
goldenSql: SELECT p.category, SUM(s.qty) FROM scm.sales_daily s JOIN scm.product p ON p.sku = s.sku WHERE s.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-01' AND DATE '2026-10-31' GROUP BY p.category

question: 어제 센터별로 얼마나 나갔는지 보여줘
goldenSql: SELECT l.name, SUM(s.qty) FROM scm.sales_daily s JOIN scm.location l ON l.location_id = s.location_id WHERE s.sale_date = DATE '2026-11-07' GROUP BY l.name

question: SKU-042 10월 12일부터 이번 주까지 주 단위 판매량 보여줘
goldenSql: SELECT CAST(date_trunc('week', sale_date) AS date) AS week_start, SUM(qty) FROM scm.sales_daily WHERE sku = 'SKU-042' AND sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-12' AND DATE '2026-11-08' GROUP BY CAST(date_trunc('week', sale_date) AS date)

question: 9월에 영남권에서 팔린 수량 총합은?

question: SKU-014 최근 14일 동안 하루 평균 출고량이 얼마야?
goldenSql: SELECT SUM(qty) / 14.0 FROM scm.sales_daily WHERE sku = 'SKU-014' AND sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-26' AND DATE '2026-11-08'
note: 도구(avg_daily_sales, sku, days 14)로 답할 수 있는 지표

question: 대구센터 SKU-031은 요즘 팔리는 속도면 지금 재고로 며칠 버텨?
goldenSql: SELECT i.on_hand / NULLIF((SELECT SUM(s.qty) FROM scm.sales_daily s WHERE s.sku = 'SKU-031' AND s.location_id = 'LOC-05' AND s.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-12' AND DATE '2026-11-08') / 28.0, 0) FROM scm.inventory_daily i WHERE i.sku = 'SKU-031' AND i.location_id = 'LOC-05' AND i.snap_date = DATE '2026-11-08'
note: 도구(days_of_supply, sku, location)로 답할 수 있는 지표. 지표 이름을 쓰지 않음

question: 부산센터 SKU-011의 9월 결품률은?
goldenSql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN on_hand = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) FROM scm.inventory_daily WHERE sku = 'SKU-011' AND location_id = 'LOC-02' AND snap_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30'
note: 도구(stockout_rate, sku, location, 날짜)로 답할 수 있는 지표

question: 서울센터 SKU-008 수요예측은 얼마나 잘 맞았어? 정확도로 알려줘
goldenSql: WITH w AS (SELECT f.forecast_qty, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.qty), 0) FROM scm.sales_daily s WHERE s.sku = f.sku AND s.location_id = f.location_id AND s.sale_date BETWEEN f.week_start AND f.week_start + 6) AS actual_qty FROM scm.forecast_weekly f WHERE f.sku = 'SKU-008' AND f.location_id = 'LOC-01') SELECT 1 - SUM(ABS(actual_qty - forecast_qty)) * 1.0 / SUM(actual_qty) FROM w
note: 도구(forecast_accuracy, sku, location)로 답할 수 있는 지표. 13주

question: 대구센터에서 안전재고 밑으로 떨어진 품목이 몇 개나 돼?
goldenSql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scm.inventory_daily i JOIN scm.supply_policy p ON p.sku = i.sku AND p.location_id = i.location_id WHERE i.snap_date = DATE '2026-11-08' AND i.location_id = 'LOC-05' AND i.on_hand < p.safety_stock
note: 도구(below_safety_stock count, location)로 답할 수 있는 지표

question: 음료 카테고리 전체로 보면 최근 7일 일평균 판매량이 어느 정도야?
goldenSql: SELECT SUM(s.qty) / 7.0 FROM scm.sales_daily s JOIN scm.product p ON p.sku = s.sku WHERE p.category = '음료' AND s.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-11-02' AND DATE '2026-11-08'
note: 조건 인자가 있어야 도구로 답할 수 있음(avg_daily_sales, category, days 7)

question: 영남권 센터들 지난달 결품률 어땠어?
goldenSql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN i.on_hand = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) FROM scm.inventory_daily i JOIN scm.location l ON l.location_id = i.location_id WHERE l.region = '영남권' AND i.snap_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-01' AND DATE '2026-10-31'
note: 조건 인자가 있어야 도구로 답할 수 있음(stockout_rate, region, 지난달)

question: A등급 품목들 묶어서 보면 재고보유일수가 며칠 정도 나와?
goldenSql: SELECT (SELECT SUM(i.on_hand) FROM scm.inventory_daily i JOIN scm.product p ON p.sku = i.sku WHERE p.abc_class = 'A' AND i.snap_date = DATE '2026-11-08') / NULLIF((SELECT SUM(s.qty) FROM scm.sales_daily s JOIN scm.product p ON p.sku = s.sku WHERE p.abc_class = 'A' AND s.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-12' AND DATE '2026-11-08') / 28.0, 0)
note: 조건 인자가 있어야 도구로 답할 수 있음(days_of_supply, abc_class A, 범위 전체 합산)

question: 냉동식품 쪽에서 지금 발주를 넣어야 하는 SKU-거점은 몇 군데야?
goldenSql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scm.inventory_daily i JOIN scm.supply_policy sp ON sp.sku = i.sku AND sp.location_id = i.location_id JOIN scm.product p ON p.sku = i.sku WHERE p.category = '냉동식품' AND i.snap_date = DATE '2026-11-08' AND i.on_hand + i.in_transit <= sp.reorder_point
note: 조건 인자가 있어야 도구로 답할 수 있음(reorder_needed count, category 냉동식품)

question: 부산센터에서 재고보유일수가 리드타임보다 짧은 품목 어디어디야?
goldenSql: WITH sold AS (SELECT sku, SUM(qty) AS qty FROM scm.sales_daily WHERE location_id = 'LOC-02' AND sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-12' AND DATE '2026-11-08' GROUP BY sku) SELECT i.sku FROM scm.inventory_daily i JOIN sold ON sold.sku = i.sku JOIN scm.supply_policy p ON p.sku = i.sku AND p.location_id = i.location_id WHERE i.location_id = 'LOC-02' AND i.snap_date = DATE '2026-11-08' AND sold.qty > 0 AND i.on_hand / (sold.qty / 28.0) < p.lead_time_days
note: 도구로 표현할 수 없는 지표(재고보유일수와 리드타임 비교, 부산센터 SKU-거점 단위)

question: SKU-003 9월 한 달 동안 일평균 판매량은?
goldenSql: SELECT SUM(qty) / 30.0 FROM scm.sales_daily WHERE sku = 'SKU-003' AND sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30'
note: 도구로 표현할 수 없는 지표(달력 구간의 일평균, 9월 30일)

question: 센터별 결품률 보여줘
goldenSql: SELECT l.name, SUM(CASE WHEN i.on_hand = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) FROM scm.inventory_daily i JOIN scm.location l ON l.location_id = i.location_id GROUP BY l.name
note: 도구로 표현할 수 없는 지표(거점 단위 결품률, 기간 미지정이라 전체 기간)

question: 최근 30일 기준 일평균 판매량 상위 5개 SKU 알려줘
goldenSql: SELECT sku, SUM(qty) / 30.0 AS avg_daily FROM scm.sales_daily WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-10' AND DATE '2026-11-08' GROUP BY sku ORDER BY avg_daily DESC, sku LIMIT 5
note: 도구(avg_daily_sales ranking, days 30)로 답할 수 있는 지표

question: 서울센터만 놓고 볼 때 재고보유일수가 긴 쪽으로 4개 품목 꼽아줘
goldenSql: WITH sold AS (SELECT sku, SUM(qty) AS qty FROM scm.sales_daily WHERE location_id = 'LOC-01' AND sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-12' AND DATE '2026-11-08' GROUP BY sku) SELECT i.sku, i.on_hand / (sold.qty / 28.0) AS dos FROM scm.inventory_daily i JOIN sold ON sold.sku = i.sku WHERE i.location_id = 'LOC-01' AND i.snap_date = DATE '2026-11-08' AND sold.qty > 0 ORDER BY dos DESC, i.sku LIMIT 4
note: 도구(days_of_supply ranking desc, location 서울센터, top_n 4)로 답할 수 있는 지표

question: 스낵 중에서 재고일수 제일 긴 품목 3개만 보여줘
goldenSql: WITH stock AS (SELECT i.sku, SUM(i.on_hand) AS on_hand FROM scm.inventory_daily i JOIN scm.product p ON p.sku = i.sku WHERE p.category = '스낵' AND i.snap_date = DATE '2026-11-08' GROUP BY i.sku), sold AS (SELECT sku, SUM(qty) AS qty FROM scm.sales_daily WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-12' AND DATE '2026-11-08' GROUP BY sku) SELECT stock.sku, stock.on_hand / (sold.qty / 28.0) AS dos FROM stock JOIN sold ON sold.sku = stock.sku WHERE sold.qty > 0 ORDER BY dos DESC, stock.sku LIMIT 3
note: 조건 인자가 있어야 도구로 답할 수 있음(days_of_supply ranking, category)

question: C등급 품목 가운데 결품률 높은 순으로 3개 보여줘
goldenSql: SELECT i.sku, SUM(CASE WHEN i.on_hand = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS stockout_rate FROM scm.inventory_daily i JOIN scm.product p ON p.sku = i.sku WHERE p.abc_class = 'C' GROUP BY i.sku ORDER BY stockout_rate DESC, i.sku LIMIT 3
note: 조건 인자가 있어야 도구로 답할 수 있음(stockout_rate ranking, abc_class C, 전체 기간)

question: 수도권 기준으로 예측 정확도가 가장 낮은 품목 3개는?
goldenSql: WITH w AS (SELECT f.sku, f.forecast_qty, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.qty), 0) FROM scm.sales_daily s WHERE s.sku = f.sku AND s.location_id = f.location_id AND s.sale_date BETWEEN f.week_start AND f.week_start + 6) AS actual_qty FROM scm.forecast_weekly f JOIN scm.location l ON l.location_id = f.location_id WHERE l.region = '수도권') SELECT sku, 1 - SUM(ABS(actual_qty - forecast_qty)) * 1.0 / SUM(actual_qty) AS accuracy FROM w GROUP BY sku ORDER BY accuracy, sku LIMIT 3
note: 조건 인자가 있어야 도구로 답할 수 있음(forecast_accuracy ranking asc, region 수도권 = 서울센터 1곳)

question: 지난달 제일 많이 팔린 품목 5개는?
goldenSql: SELECT sku, SUM(qty) AS total_qty FROM scm.sales_daily WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-01' AND DATE '2026-10-31' GROUP BY sku ORDER BY total_qty DESC, sku LIMIT 5

question: 현재 재고를 많이 들고 있는 센터 순으로 정렬해줘
goldenSql: SELECT l.name, SUM(i.on_hand) AS total_on_hand FROM scm.inventory_daily i JOIN scm.location l ON l.location_id = i.location_id WHERE i.snap_date = DATE '2026-11-08' GROUP BY l.name ORDER BY total_on_hand DESC, l.name
note: 일반 집계 순위. 거점 단위 기준일 재고
